title: Archbishop Hoban — Baseball (2025–2026)
summary: Archbishop Hoban Knights baseball — photography and game coverage from the 2025–2026 high school season.
article_headline: A Season on the Diamond: Archbishop Hoban Baseball
article_dek: A visual archive of the Knights’ 2025–26 baseball season.
article_body:
A baseball season is built from countless details: the concentration before a pitch, the quick exchanges between defenders and the movement of runners on the bases. Those moments matter beyond any single result.

Mason Bybee’s collection follows Archbishop Hoban baseball across the 2025–26 school year. This is a season-long photo essay, not a recap of one particular game.
